status: DRAFT: proposed by a code session, UNSIGNED, not run, capts dataset versions NOT yet pinned (null). Becomes binding only when the coordinator has pinned them (run_rel04_verify.py pin), applied the registry edit, bound and signed the prereg.

identity.must_be_identical: every column of events.parquet except receive_ts, row for row in file order, same schema, same row count
identity.receive_ts: may differ; must be >= exchange_ts in every candidate row; must differ from the reference in at least one row; dataset.json source.receive_ts must be 'iex_capture'

features.runs_only_if: identity passes on all six days
features.args: exactly the process-iex-day features step: --data-dir <ds>/normalized --out-dir <ds>/features --configs <ds>/configs --registry-out <ds>/features/feature_registry.json --workers 1 --engine rust; every other iap.features option at its default
features.not_done_here: the keep and delete steps of process-iex-day (KEEP.json, normalized clean-up) are not run; the normalized files stay

latency.source: dataset.json sessions[day].messages.iex.feed_latency and sessions[day].raw.capture_ts_* counters; no event is read
latency.interpretation: within-capture differences only: the capture clock offset to IEX's send clock is unknown (iex.CAPTURE_TS_PROVENANCE)

statistics.family: deterministic identity check and descriptive summary; no hypothesis test
statistics.inference: none: no p-value, interval or comparison across days is claimed; counts are exact

decision_rule.day_passes: row counts equal AND schema equal AND zero mismatching rows in every non-receive_ts column AND zero candidate rows with receive_ts < exchange_ts AND at least one candidate row with receive_ts != reference receive_ts AND dataset.json source.receive_ts == 'iex_capture'
decision_rule.identity: pass only if all six days pass; otherwise fail
decision_rule.on_fail: features are not built; the mismatches are reported as found; the capture-ts datasets are not used downstream until the cause is understood (a fix is a new declaration)

refuse: prereg unsigned, identity mismatch, runner is the signer, or a signing key in the environment
a capts_dataset_version still null, or the dataset on disk differs from a declared version
any of the twelve datasets missing, unregistered, not listed in the registry datasets as spent, or not authorised for this prereg id by the guard
a result file of this run already exists (one run only)
abort: available RAM below min_free_ram_gb or free disk below min_free_disk_gb at start
iap.features exits non-zero on a day: that day's log is kept, the run stops, nothing is retried
stop_rules.no_rerun: one run; a parameter change is a new declaration, never a retry

can_claim: on six IEX overlap days the capture-timestamp ingest changed receive_ts and nothing else in events.parquet (or exactly which columns and rows differ)
the recorded within-capture feed-latency distribution per day, as a descriptive count summary
features for the six capture-timestamp datasets exist, built by the declared command
cannot_claim: the absolute IEX feed latency: the capture clock's source and its offset to IEX's send clock are unknown (iex.CAPTURE_TS_PROVENANCE)
the skew against any Nasdaq stamp
that negative latencies are errors or that positive ones are physical delays
any signal, edge, fill or profit result, any holdout result, any significance

reproducibility.note: no random draws; same inputs give byte-identical JSON
